consequence.statement: Updates to commonly mutated resources and .status changes are ignored by default, reducing load, which differs from v2 behavior.
consequence.remediation: Override or remove the default resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates settings in the argocd-cm ConfigMap to preserve v2 behavior.

assertion.statement: The Argo CD manifest now ships a default resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates configuration in argocd-cm that ignores updates for commonly mutated resources, and .status changes are always ignored; override or remove the defaults to keep v2 behavior.
